newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha easy with amid scant end-user demand.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha easy with amid scant end-user demand.

text.p: NWE naphtha was easy with slack end-user demand leaving prices tracking Iraqi oil sale led weakness in crude futures, traders said.
There was little sign of a continuance of last week's supportive U.S. demand for high paraffinic naphtha but some traders felt that increasing freight costs may start to restrict this option.
They said end-user buying interest was very thin in Europe leaving spot prices and December swaps some $2-3 a tonne lower at around $230 cif NWE.
